content.comment_body: Hello, what is the maximum size for data logging? Currently, I have a one-minute record that produces 2000 lines (about 109 kilobytes), which doesn't go beyond that. The storage card has 16 megabytes. The module used is [product_name] with article number [article_no]. Thank you
According to the manual, a data log file on the SD card can store up to 2,000 records.
Apologies, my previous instructions referred to [product_name] version [version_no] and [version_no].

Timing may not be favorable for this scenario. How many data points do you plan to record at each interval? You might want to calculate what interval in milliseconds you have available for each recording step. The [product_name] is not designed for rapid cycles, and external memory card access must also be considered. Refer to the System Manual for [product_name] and review relevant notes.

Can you clarify what you have currently—a [product_name] with article number [article_no] or another model? If you have [product_name] version [version_no], these can store up to 20,000 lines on the SD Card.
I use both hardware versions, and initially, I read the instructions for [version_no] without noticing the differences. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to determine the maximum data logging limit for [company_name] modules, specifically comparing different [version_no] hardware. There's some confusion due to differences in specifications and incomplete understanding of each version's storage capabilities.
